Ubiquiti airFiber POE-24-AF5X 24V 1A PoE Injector

The Ubiquiti airFiber POE-24-AF5X 24V 1A (24W) PoE Injector is a high-performance power solution designed specifically for Ubiquiti airFiber devices. It ensures a stable and reliable power supply while supporting high-speed data transmission through its Gigabit LAN port. This PoE injector is an essential accessory for users who need a seamless power and data connection for their airFiber network devices. The POE-24-AF5X delivers 24V-1.0A of power, ensuring optimal performance for your airFiber device. It is built to support a wide input voltage range (90-260VAC @ 47-63Hz), making it suitable for different power environments worldwide. Whether you are using it for home or business networking, this injector provides stable and efficient power delivery. This PoE injector is equipped with a reset button and remote reset capability, allowing users to reboot connected devices effortlessly. This feature is especially useful for troubleshooting and maintenance, saving time and effort by avoiding the need to physically access the device. Designed in a compact form factor (88 x 57 x 33mm), the Ubiquiti POE-24-AF5X is easy to install and does not take up much space. The black, durable casing ensures longevity and protection against external elements. Despite its small size, it is solidly built with a weight of 158.5g (5.59oz), ensuring durability and long-lasting performance. If you are looking for a reliable and efficient 24V PoE injector for your Ubiquiti airFiber device, the POE-24-AF5X is the perfect choice. It offers seamless power delivery, advanced reset features, and robust construction, making it an ideal solution for both professional and personal network setups.

Features of Ubiquiti airFiber POE-24-AF5X 24V 1A PoE Injector

  • Stable Power Output – Provides 24V-1.0A (24W) power supply, ensuring a reliable connection for Ubiquiti airFiber devices.
  • Wide Input Voltage Range – Supports 90-260VAC @ 47-63Hz, making it compatible with various power sources worldwide.
  • Gigabit LAN Port – Equipped with a Gigabit Ethernet port, allowing high-speed data transmission without interruptions.
  • Remote Reset Capability – Enables users to remotely reset connected devices for convenient troubleshooting and maintenance.
  • Built-in Reset Button – Features a reset button for quick and easy device reboots without disconnecting power.
  • Compact & Lightweight Design – With dimensions of 88 x 57 x 33mm (3.47 x 2.24 x 1.30″) and a weight of 158.5g (5.59oz), it is easy to install and handle.
  • Durable Build Quality – Housed in a black, sturdy casing, ensuring long-term durability and protection.
  • Optimized for airFiber Devices – Specially designed for Ubiquiti airFiber products, delivering maximum efficiency and performance.
